questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.TransactionID) FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID WHERE T2.Country = 'CZE' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Date) >= '2012'
questions.pred_sql: SELECT COUNT(t1.TransactionID) FROM transactions_1k AS t1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS t2 ON t1.GasStationID = t2.GasStationID WHERE t2.Country = 'CZE' AND t1.Date > '2012-01-01'

questions.question: How was Francesco Migliore's attacking work rate on 2015/5/1?
questions.evidence: Francesco Migliore refers to player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'; on 2015/5/1 refers to date LIKE '2015-05-01%';
questions.gold_sql: SELECT t2.attacking_work_rate FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE t2.`date` LIKE '2015-05-01%' AND t1.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'
questions.pred_sql: SELECT t1.attacking_work_rate FROM Player_Attributes AS t1 INNER JOIN Player AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE t2.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore' AND t1.date LIKE '2015-05-01%'

questions.question: Among the Artifact cards, which are black color and comes with foreign languague translation?
questions.evidence: Artifact card refers to originalType = 'Artifact'; black color refers to colors = 'B'; foreign language refers to language in foreign_data
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.name FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.originalType = 'Artifact' AND T1.colors = 'B'
questions.pred_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM cards AS c INNER JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid WHERE c.originalType = 'Artifact' AND c.colors = 'B'

questions.question: Provide the IDs and age of the client with high level credit card, which is eligible for loans.
questions.evidence: the credit card is high-level refers to card.type = 'gold'; eligible for loans refers to disp.type = 'OWNER'
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.client_id, STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T3.birth_date) FROM disp AS T1 INNER JOIN card AS T2 ON T2.disp_id = T1.disp_id INNER JOIN client AS T3 ON T1.client_id = T3.client_id WHERE T2.type = 'gold' AND T1.type = 'OWNER'
questions.pred_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) AS age FROM client AS c INNER JOIN disp AS d ON c.client_id = d.client_id INNER JOIN card AS ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id WHERE ca.type = 'gold' AND d.type = 'OWNER'
